name: IMSCARED
author: hatoving
description: IMSCARED is a metahorror game that protagonizes the player, putting him in a surreal first-person experience. Find keys, open doors and search for the exit to this nightmare. But I need to let you know, it will try to deceive You as many times as it can. Read the github page on how to get the game working.
requirements:
- YoYo Loader
- Game Data Files: PC Steam
